investment_strategy: Constructive-but-defensive AI barbell for 12–18 months. Overweight profitable mega-cap AI platforms (Microsoft, Alphabet) that pair strong fundamentals and monetization paths with relatively lower volatility versus the broader AI complex, and add a smaller satellite in the semiconductor enabler (NVIDIA) to capture cycle upside. Elevated VIX (~23) and 10Y yields (~4.3%) argue for quality bias, disciplined sizing, and tolerance for episodic drawdowns from regulation and export controls. Rebalance quarterly or on >10% single-name dislocations; add on VIX spikes >28 if fundamentals remain intact. Focus on durable free cash flow, enterprise AI adoption, and diversified revenue levers across cloud, software, ads, and chips. Expect headline risk around antitrust and export controls; position sizes reflect this. Goal: compound through AI monetization while managing downside via concentration in high-quality leaders.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: AI platform core (MSFT, GOOGL) with a measured semiconductor enabler (NVDA); overweight quality to navigate higher rates and volatility.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive analyst consensus, and momentum. Considered ROE, balance sheet strength, earnings surprise history, and news themes (AI arms race, regulation, energy constraints). Sized positions to manage drawdown risk under VIX >20 and 10Y ~4.3%.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive but volatile: Generative AI monetization supports leaders across cloud, ads, and devices; expect episodic pullbacks from antitrust actions and export controls. Favor profitable mega-cap platforms and core chip enablers; stagger entries and rebalance on dislocations.
